author: SA Editor Brandy Betz
title: Bank of America Merrill Lynch estimates Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL

organizations.name: aapl bank of america merrill lynch

text:
Bank of America Merrill Lynch estimates Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) can save $500M each year by switching from Intel (NASDAQ: INTC ) to in-house PC chips for even half its Macs.
Analyst Wamsi Mohan says the switch could lower the material cost of Macs by $40 to $50 each.
Firm reiterates a Buy rating on Apple with a $220 price target.
Apple shares are up 1.1% to $168.45.
